name: Mount Sharp boxwork region (HOMELINE pad), Gale crater
credit: Topography: USGS Astrogeology MSL Gale Merged DEM 1 m + Orthophoto 25 cm v3 (MRO HiRISE, NASA/JPL-Caltech/Univ. of Arizona); MRO CTX DTM (USGS); MOLA-HRSC blended DEM v2 200 m (USGS Astrogeology; MGS MOLA NASA/GSFC, MEX HRSC ESA/DLR/FU Berlin); Curiosity waypoints NASA/JPL-Caltech MMGIS

play.derivation: USGS MSL Gale DEM 1 m v3, DEM columns 12365..18509, rows 36805..42949, area-averaged to 4097 posts (1.5 DEM pixels per post), minus the curvature drop r^2/2R from the spawn; the outer 144 m are blended into the 32 m backdrop surface (derived, not measured). Tools/mountsharp/build_play_terrain.py
play.splatDerivation: inside the original 4 km (144 m or more from its border): the original map, resampled; elsewhere: derived by rule from the DEM slope and the HiRISE image brightness (table learned on the original area, Tools/mountsharp/build_play_terrain.py derive_splat), which reproduces the original map's dominant layer on 84.8% of the original area; the outer 144 m fade into backdrop_splat.png

splatRuleAgreement.measuredOn: the original area, 144 m or more inside its border (1612900 texels)
